memories.text: A p-value is the probability of data at least this extreme if the null hypothesis is true; it is not the probability that the null hypothesis is true.

fields.subject: p_value
fields.object: probability of data this extreme under the null

memories.text: A 95% confidence interval means that 95% of intervals built this way from repeated samples contain the true value; it is not a 95% probability for this one interval.
Correct for multiple comparisons with Bonferroni or Benjamini-Hochberg when testing more than one hypothesis.
Check test assumptions: plot the residuals, run Shapiro-Wilk for normality and Levene for equal variance, and switch to a nonparametric test if they fail.

steps: use a nonparametric test if assumptions fail

memories.text: Choose a test: two independent groups with normal data use a t-test, otherwise Mann-Whitney; three or more groups use ANOVA or Kruskal-Wallis; paired data use a paired t-test or Wilcoxon.

steps: two independent groups: t-test if normal, else Mann-Whitney
three or more groups: ANOVA, or Kruskal-Wallis if not normal
paired data: paired t-test, or Wilcoxon if not normal

memories.text: Do not delete outliers without a rule stated in advance; report results with and without them.
Take logs of right-skewed positive data before parametric tests and back-transform for reporting.
Plot the data first and report the correlation coefficient with its confidence interval; correlation is not causation.
A regression coefficient flipped sign after a collinear predictor was added; check variance inflation factors.

fields.situation: a regression coefficient changes sign when a predictor is added

memories.text: A Bayes factor above 10 is strong evidence for a hypothesis and one below 3 is only anecdotal.
Round p-values to three decimals and effect sizes to two.
State the full model formula with every predictor and interaction in the methods section.
At the May lab meeting a non-significant result was read as proof of no effect; absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.

Analyses use R 4.4 with the tidyverse; Python is for pipelines only.
Chose Benjamini-Hochberg over Bonferroni for gene expression screens because Bonferroni was too conservative.

fields.rationale: Bonferroni was too conservative for thousands of tests
